title: The Universe Has No Center
fact: The universe has no center because it is expanding uniformly in all directions from every point. There is no special location from which to measure expansion.

title: Your Nose Makes 1 Liter of Mucus Daily
fact: You produce about 1-1.5 liters of nasal mucus per day. Most of it gets swallowed unconsciously, which is completely normal.

title: The Amazon Rainforest Is 5.5 Million km²
fact: The Amazon rainforest covers about 5.5 million square kilometers, spanning nine countries. It is the largest tropical rainforest in the world.

title: A Group of Leopards Is Called a Leap
fact: A group of leopards is called a leap. Leopards are the most widespread of all big cats, found across Africa and Asia.

title: The First Email Was Sent in 1971
fact: Ray Tomlinson sent the first network email in 1971, using the @ sign to separate usernames from computer names. He chose QWERTYUIOP as the first message.

title: Forests Help Combat Climate Change
fact: Forests absorb about 2.6 billion tons of CO2 annually, helping to mitigate climate change. Protecting forests is crucial for meeting climate goals.

title: The Black Death Killed 30-60% of Europe's Population
fact: The Black Death (1347-1351) killed an estimated 75-200 million people, wiping out 30-60% of Europe's population in just a few years.

title: A Group of Whales Is Called a Pod
fact: A group of whales is called a pod. Blue whales are the largest animals ever known to exist, reaching up to 100 feet in length.

title: The Sun Contains 99.86% of Solar System Mass
fact: The Sun contains 99.86% of all mass in the solar system. Jupiter accounts for most of the remaining 0.14%.

title: Your Brain Shrinks With Age
fact: The brain begins shrinking around age 30 and loses about 0.5-1% of its volume per year after that. This can affect memory and cognitive function.

title: Mount Everest Is 29,029 Feet Tall
fact: Mount Everest stands at 29,029 feet (8,848 meters) above sea level, making it the tallest mountain on Earth. It grows about 4mm taller each year.

title: A Group of Hippos Is Called a Pod
fact: A group of hippos is called a pod. Despite their cute appearance, hippos are among Africa's most dangerous animals.

title: The First Computer Mouse Was Made of Wood
fact: Douglas Engelbart invented the computer mouse in 1964, which was made of wood with two wheels. It took nearly 20 years before it became commercially available.

title: Trees Can Reduce Urban Temperatures
fact: Urban trees can reduce air temperatures by 2-8°F through shade and evapotranspiration. This reduces energy costs and improves air quality.

title: The Roman Empire Lasted Over 500 Years
fact: The Roman Empire lasted from 27 BCE to 476 CE, spanning over 500 years. At its height, it controlled about 5 million square kilometers.

title: A Group of Finches Is Called a Charm
fact: A group of finches is called a charm. Darwin's finches from the Galapagos Islands helped shape his theory of evolution.

title: Neutron Stars Spin 716 Times Per Second
fact: The fastest known neutron star, PSR J1748-2446ad, rotates 716 times per second. This is near the theoretical limit before the star would fly apart.

title: Your Skin Has 3 Layers
fact: Human skin has three main layers: epidermis (outer), dermis (middle), and hypodermis (inner). Together, they form the body's largest organ.

title: The Great Barrier Reef Has 1,500 Fish Species
fact: The Great Barrier Reef is home to about 1,500 species of fish, 4,000 types of mollusks, and 400 species of coral.

title: A Group of Shrimp Is Called an Army
fact: A group of shrimp is called an army. Mantis shrimp have the most complex eyes in the animal kingdom, with 16 color receptors.

title: HTML Was Created by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990
fact: Tim Berners-Lee invented HTML in 1990 as part of the World Wide Web project at CERN. It remains the foundation of web pages today.

title: Forests Store 45% of Earth's Carbon
fact: Forests store about 45% of all carbon stored on land, primarily in their biomass (trunks, branches, leaves) and soil.

title: The First Humans Evolved 300,000 Years Ago
fact: Homo sapiens evolved in Africa about 300,000 years ago. Early humans migrated out of Africa about 70,000 years ago.

title: A Group of Raccoons Is Called a Gaze
fact: A group of raccoons is called a gaze. Raccoons can rotate their paws 180 degrees to manipulate objects with great dexterity.

title: The Largest Galaxy Has 100 Trillion Stars
fact: IC 1101 is the largest known galaxy, containing about 100 trillion stars and stretching 6 million light-years across.

title: Your Bones Are Stronger Than Steel
fact: Bone is stronger than steel gram for gram. A matchbox-sized block of bone could support 10 tons of weight.

title: The Sahara Was Green 6,000 Years Ago
fact: About 6,000 years ago, the Sahara was green with savannas, lakes, and rivers. Changes in Earth's orbit turned it into a desert.

title: A Group of Crabs Is Called a Cast
fact: A group of crabs is called a cast. Fiddler crabs can regenerate lost limbs, including their large cheliped claw.

title: The First Pixel Was Displayed in 1957
fact: Russell Kirsch created the first digital image in 1957: a 176x176 pixel picture of his son. Each pixel was a simple square.

title: Trees Can Absorb 100 Gallons of Water Daily
fact: A large tree can absorb and transpire up to 100 gallons of water daily, helping regulate local humidity and rainfall patterns.

title: The Industrial Revolution Started in Britain in 1760
fact: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain around 1760, transforming economies from agricultural to industrial. It spread to Europe and America by the 1800s.

title: A Group of Ferrets Is Called a Business
fact: A group of ferrets is called a business. Ferrets have been domesticated for over 2,000 years for hunting rabbits.

title: The Moon Is 4.5 Billion Years Old
fact: The Moon formed about 4.5 billion years ago, shortly after Earth. It likely formed when a Mars-sized body collided with early Earth.

title: Your Brain Is 73% Water
fact: The brain is 73% water, and even 2% dehydration can impair cognitive function, mood, and concentration.

title: The Nile River Flows Northward
fact: The Nile River flows northward from Lake Victoria to the Mediterranean Sea, contrary to the common misconception that rivers flow south.

title: A Group of Monkeys Is Called a Troop
fact: A group of monkeys is called a troop. Spider monkeys haveprehensile tails that can support their entire body weight.

title: Python Was Named After Monty Python
fact: Guido van Rossum named Python after Monty Python, not the snake. He was reading their scripts when developing the language.

title: Forests Help Prevent Soil Erosion
fact: Tree roots bind soil together, reducing erosion by up to 90% compared to cleared land. This protects waterways and farmland.

title: The First Moon Landing Was in 1969
fact: Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Armstrong's first words were 'one small step for man.'

title: A Group of Cranes Is Called a Herd
fact: A group of cranes is called a herd or sedge. Whooping cranes are among the tallest flying birds in North America.

title: The Hubble Orbits Earth Every 95 Minutes
fact: The Hubble Space Telescope orbits Earth at about 340 miles altitude, completing one orbit every 95 minutes. It has observed objects 13.4 billion light-years away.

title: Your Lungs Breathe 20,000 Times Daily
fact: You breathe about 20,000 times per day, moving 300 million liters of air annually. This supplies oxygen to every cell.

title: Lake Victoria Is Africa's Largest Lake
fact: Lake Victoria is the largest lake in Africa and the second largest freshwater lake in the world, covering 68,800 square kilometers.

title: A Group of Llamas Is Called a Herd
fact: A group of llamas is called a herd. Llamas are native to South America and have been used as pack animals for thousands of years.

title: The First Search Engine Was Created in 1990
fact: Archie, created in 1990 by Alan Emtage, was the first internet search engine. It indexed FTP sites but couldn't search within documents.

title: Trees Can Reduce Healthcare Costs
fact: Areas with more trees have lower rates of asthma, heart disease, and stress. Urban forests can reduce healthcare costs by millions.

title: The Declaration of Independence Was Signed in 1776
fact: The Declaration of Independence was signed July 4, 1776, declaring independence from Britain. 56 delegates signed it.

title: A Group of Mules Is Called a Pack
fact: A group of mules is called a pack. Mules are hybrids of a male donkey and female horse, known for their strength and endurance.

title: The Universe Is 13.8 Billion Years Old
fact: The universe began with the Big Bang about 13.8 billion years ago. The first stars formed about 200 million years after this event.

title: Your Tongue Has 8,000 Taste Buds
fact: The tongue has about 8,000 taste buds, each containing 50-100 receptor cells. Taste buds are replaced every 1-2 weeks.

title: The Amazon River Discharges 7.2 Million Cubic Feet Per Second
fact: The Amazon River discharges about 7.2 million cubic feet of water per second into the Atlantic, more than any other river.

title: A Group of Owls Is Called a Parliament
fact: A group of owls is called a parliament, wisdom, or congress. Owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees.

title: The First Smartphone Virus Appeared in 2004
fact: Cabir was the first smartphone virus, appearing in 2004. It infected Symbian phones via Bluetooth and displayed 'Caribe.'

title: Forests Provide 13 Million Jobs
fact: The forestry sector provides employment to about 13 million people worldwide. Forests support the livelihoods of 1.6 billion people.

title: The Printing Press Was Invented in 1440
fact: Johannes Gutenberg invented the printing press around 1440, revolutionizing book production. The Gutenberg Bible was the first major book printed.

title: A Group of Parrots Is Called a Pandemonium
fact: A group of parrots is called a pandemonium. Parrots are among the most intelligent birds and can learn to mimic human speech.

title: Pluto Has Heart-Shaped Glacier
fact: Pluto has a heart-shaped glacier called Tombaugh Regio, about 1,000 miles wide. It's one of the most recognizable features in the solar system.

title: Your Brain Uses 20% of Body Energy
fact: Despite being only 2% of body weight, the brain uses 20% of the body's energy. This makes it vulnerable to low blood sugar.

title: Australia Has More Sheep Than People
fact: Australia has about 70 million sheep but only about 25 million people. Australia is one of the world's largest wool producers.

title: A Group of Seals Is Called a Rookery
fact: A group of seals is called a rookery. Seals can hold their breath for up to 2 hours while diving for food.

title: WiFi Uses 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Frequencies
fact: WiFi operates mainly on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz radio frequencies. Lower frequencies travel farther but slower; higher frequencies are faster but shorter range.

title: Trees Can Absorb Sound Pollution
fact: A 100-foot-wide forest belt can reduce noise by 50%. Dense foliage absorbs and scatters sound waves effectively.

title: The Berlin Wall Fell in 1989
fact: The Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989, after standing for 28 years. Its fall symbolized the end of the Cold War division of Europe.

title: A Group of Buffalo Is Called an Obstinacy
fact: A group of buffalo is called an obstinacy. American bison can run up to 35 mph despite weighing up to 2,000 pounds.

title: The Sun Is 4.6 Billion Years Old
fact: The Sun formed about 4.6 billion years ago from a cloud of gas and dust. It has enough hydrogen fuel to continue burning for another 5 billion years.

title: Your Hair Grows 6 Inches Per Year
fact: Hair grows about 0.3-0.4 mm per day, or 6 inches per year. Growth is faster in summer than winter.

title: The Mariana Trench Is 36,070 Feet Deep
fact: The Mariana Trench reaches 36,070 feet at its deepest point. The pressure there is over 1,000 times atmospheric pressure.

title: A Group of Bears Is Called a Sleuth
fact: A group of bears is called a sleuth or sloth. Polar bears are the largest land carnivores, reaching up to 1,500 pounds.

title: GPS Satellites Need Constant Time Corrections
fact: GPS satellites experience time dilation due to their speed and weaker gravity, causing clocks to tick faster by 45 microseconds per day.

title: Forests Can Take 100 Years to Recover
fact: After clear-cutting, a forest can take 100-200 years to fully recover its biodiversity and ecological functions.

title: The Trojan War Was Mythological
fact: The Trojan War, described in Homer's Iliad, is considered mythological, but archaeological evidence suggests a real Troy existed in Turkey.

title: A Group of Skunks Is Called a Stench
fact: A group of skunks is called a stench. Their spray can be detected by humans from up to 1.5 miles away.

title: Venus Spins Backwards Compared to Other Planets
fact: Venus rotates clockwise (retrograde) while most planets rotate counterclockwise. A day on Venus is longer than its year.

title: Your Brain Has 86 Billion Neurons
fact: The human brain contains about 86 billion neurons, each connected to thousands of others via synapses.

title: The Sahara Desert Is Growing
fact: The Sahara Desert is expanding southward by about 30-60 miles per decade due to climate change and reduced rainfall in the Sahel region.

title: A Group of Iguanas Is Called a Massacre
fact: A group of iguanas is called a massacre. Marine iguanas from the Galapagos are the only seagoing lizards.

title: JavaScript Was Created in 10 Days
fact: Brendan Eich created JavaScript in 10 days in 1995. Originally called LiveScript, it became one of the most widely used programming languages.

title: Forests Produce Medicinal Compounds
fact: About 25% of modern medicines come from rainforest plants. Many more potential medicines remain undiscovered.

title: The First GPS Satellite Was Launched in 1978
fact: The first GPS satellite was launched in 1978. The full GPS constellation of 24 satellites became operational in 1995.

title: A Group of Hares Is Called a Husk
fact: A group of hares is called a husk. Arctic hares can reach speeds of 40 mph to escape predators.

title: Mars Has the Tallest Mountain in Solar System
fact: Olympus Mons on Mars is 72,000 feet tall, nearly three times Mount Everest's height. It's a shield volcano billions of years old.

title: Your Stomach Produces 2 Liters of Acid Daily
fact: Your stomach produces about 2 liters of hydrochloric acid daily. This powerful acid has a pH of 1-2.

title: Canada Has 60% of World's Lakes
fact: Canada has about 60% of all the lakes in the world, with over 2 million lakes covering about 9% of its territory.

title: A Group of Foxes Is Called a Skulk
fact: A group of foxes is called a skulk. Red foxes can hear a mouse squeak from 100 feet away.

title: The First Computer Bug Was an Actual Moth
fact: In 1947, a moth was found dead in the Harvard Mark II computer, causing a malfunction. The log entry reads 'First actual case of bug being found.'

title: Trees Can Live for Thousands of Years
fact: Bristlecone pines can live over 5,000 years, making them the longest-lived organisms on Earth. Some clonal colonies are even older.

title: The Magna Carta Was Signed in 1215
fact: The Magna Carta was signed by King John of England in 1215, establishing that everyone, including the king, was subject to the law.

title: A Group of Elephants Is Called a Herd
fact: A group of elephants is called a herd. Female elephants live in matriarchal societies led by the oldest female.

title: The Moon Has Quakes That Last 10 Minutes
fact: The Moon experiences moonquakes that can last up to 10 minutes, much longer than earthquakes. Some are caused by Earth's gravitational pull.

title: Your Brain Weighs About 3 Pounds
fact: The adult human brain weighs about 3 pounds (1.4 kg) and contains 86 billion neurons. Despite being only 2% of body weight, it uses 20% of energy.

title: The Amazon Has 15,000 Tree Species
fact: The Amazon contains at least 15,000 tree species. A single hectare may contain 750 different tree species.

title: A Group of Crows Is Called a Murder
fact: A group of crows is called a murder. Crows are highly intelligent and can recognize human faces for years.

title: Bluetooth Is Named After a King
fact: Bluetooth is named after King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark, who united Scandinavian tribes. His initials BH form the Bluetooth symbol.

title: Forests Help Reduce Stress Levels
fact: Studies show that spending time in forests reduces stress hormones, lowers blood pressure, and improves mood.

title: The French Revolution Started in 1789
fact: The French Revolution began on July 14, 1789, with the storming of the Bastille. It transformed France from a monarchy to a republic.

title: A Group of Starlings Is Called a Murmuration
fact: A group of starlings is called a murmuration. These large groups create mesmerizing coordinated flight patterns.

title: The Milky Way Is 100,000 Light-Years Wide
fact: The Milky Way is about 100,000 light-years in diameter and contains 100-400 billion stars. It would take 100,000 years to cross at light speed.

title: Your Lungs Have 300 Million Alveoli
fact: Your lungs contain about 300 million tiny air sacs (alveoli). If spread flat, they would cover about 70 square meters.

title: The Great Barrier Reef Is 1,400 Miles Long
fact: The Great Barrier Reef in Australia stretches over 1,400 miles. It is the world's largest coral reef system.

title: A Group of Wildebeest Is Called a Cracker
fact: A group of wildebeest is called a cracker. Each year, 1.5 million wildebeest migrate across the Serengeti.
